facts.text: Evan took his family on a road trip to Jasper last weekend.

evidence.quote: Last weekend, I took my family on a road trip to Jasper.

facts.text: Evan and his family drove through the Icefields Parkway and saw glaciers and lakes during their road trip.

evidence.quote: We drove through the Icefields Parkway and the glaciers and lakes were gorgeous.

facts.text: Evan described the road trip as relaxing, with fresh air, peacefulness, and a cozy cabin surrounded by mountains and forests.

evidence.quote: It was great - fresh air, peacefulness and a cozy cabin surrounded by mountains and forests made it feel like a real retreat.
